task:
Create a single self-contained HTML file for a mobile card-draw game called 「孩子气·真心话大冒险」. No external dependencies. All CSS and JS inline. All graphics use inline SVG.

## Visual Identity (from theme.json)
- Primary red: #CC1B1B
- Card front bg: #F5F0EB (cream)
- Card back bg: #CC1B1B (red)
- Text: #1A1A1A
- Font stack: -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
- Card shape: tall bookmark ratio ~1:3.8, border-radius 16px

## Structure
Single HTML file with two views toggled by JS class:
- `#view-bucket` (default visible)
- `#view-card` (hidden initially)

## View 1: Bucket Screen
- Body bg: #F5F0EB
- Top: h1 "孩子气·真心话大冒险" color #CC1B1B, font-size 20px, text-align center, padding-top 48px
- Center: inline SVG depicting white cylinder bucket with 10 red card strips fanning out from top (strips are rotated rectangles at angles -40 to +40 deg, varied heights)
- Below SVG: red pill button "点击抽签" (background #CC1B1B, color white, border-radius 50px, padding 14px 40px, font-size 18px)
- Clicking button or SVG calls drawCard()

## View 2: Card Screen
- Body bg: #1a0a0a
- Center: .card-wrapper div (width: 75vw, max-width: 260px, margin: auto, perspective: 1000px)
- Inside: .card-inner (transform-style: preserve-3d, transition: transform 0.6s)
  - .card-front (backface-visibility: hidden, position absolute)
  - .card-back (backface-visibility: hidden, transform: rotateY(180deg), position absolute)
- When .flipped class on .card-inner: transform rotateY(180deg)
- Clicking .card-wrapper toggles .flipped

### Card Front (.card-front): bg #F5F0EB, border-radius 16px, padding 16px
Top section (white bg):
1. Header row: left side small text (font-size 9px, color #CC1B1B, line-height 1.3): "你这样看世界啊" / "SO, THIS IS HOW YOU SEE THE WORLD" — right side: "孩子气" bold red + small hand SVG icon (simple outline hand, 24x24)
2. Large red quote mark " (font-size 32px, color #CC1B1B, margin: 8px 0 4px)
3. .question-zh: font-size 24px, font-weight 700, color #1A1A1A, line-height 1.4
4. .question-en: font-size 11px, color #888, margin-top 4px
5. hr: border-top 1px solid #CC1B1B, margin 10px 0
6. span "替换词：" color #CC1B1B, font-weight 700, font-size 12px
7. .subs-zh: color #CC1B1B, font-size 13px, margin 4px 0
8. em "Substitution:" color #CC1B1B, font-size 11px
9. .subs-en: color #555, font-size 11px

Bottom section (doodle area): a 200px tall div with an inline SVG pattern of hand-drawn doodle icons (hearts, envelopes, birds, small flowers, arrows) scattered across — use simple SVG paths, stroke #CC1B1B, fill none, stroke-width 1.5, about 15-20 small icons spread across the area

Closing quote " bottom right, color #CC1B1B, font-size 20px

### Card Back (.card-back): bg #CC1B1B, border-radius 16px, padding 16px
Same structure but:
- All text white
- hr: border-top 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4)
- Doodle SVG strokes: white

### Below card: hint text "点击卡牌可翻面" (color #aaa, font-size 12px, margin-top 12px, text-align center)

Bottom fixed button: "再抽一张" (position fixed, bottom 32px, left 50%, transform translateX(-50%), bg white, color #CC1B1B, border-radius 50px, padding 14px 48px, font-size 17px, font-weight 600, box-shadow 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3))

## Animations
- drawCard(): 
  1. Add .drawing class to #view-bucket (opacity goes 0, pointer-events none, transition 300ms)
  2. After 300ms: hide #view-bucket, populate card data, show #view-card with opacity 0
  3. Add .visible class to #view-card (opacity 1, transition 300ms)
  4. .card-inner starts with slight scale(0.8), animates to scale(1) via CSS transition 400ms

- returnToBucket():
  1. Remove .flipped from .card-inner
  2. #view-card fades out (300ms)
  3. Show #view-bucket, fade in
